Why TG CareHomes

Individual goals.
Thoughtful support.

At Thompson Global LLC, we believe a supportive home should make room for each person's voice, strengths, and aspirations.

  • Person-centered livingDaily routines shaped by personal preferences and the Person-Centered Support Plan.
  • Connected partnershipsCommunication with families, guardians, and Targeted Case Managers.
  • A welcoming homeCompassionate assistance, comfortable spaces, and opportunities for community inclusion.

Mission & vision

Dignity is where
we begin.

Our mission is to provide safe, compassionate, and person-centered residential care that empowers adults with intellectual and developmental disabilities to live with dignity, independence, and joy.

Our vision is to be a trusted partner for individuals with IDD, their families, and Targeted Case Managers across Wyandotte County.

Dignity & respect

Honor each person's choices, privacy, and individuality.

Safety & accountability

A responsible, attentive approach to everyday support.

Partnership

Residents, families, guardians, and case managers working together.

Payment & admissions

Your next chapter.
Three simple steps.

Start with a conversation. We will discuss individual needs and help clarify the path forward.

1

Let's connect.

Call to discuss residential availability, individual support needs, and family or TCM referral next steps.

2

Come say hello.

Arrange a visit with the prospective resident, family or guardian, and case manager.

3

Plan together.

Review the support plan, confirm eligibility and funding as applicable, and coordinate next steps.

Questions about funding?

Contact the team to confirm private-pay arrangements and the current status of KanCare and HCBS IDD Waiver participation. Funding acceptance and provider approval have not been verified for this preview.
